limitations: Live provider semantic quality, first-token latency and billing were not tested.
Real-device microphone/service behavior is not certified by simulated recognition tests; hosted Storage is independently verified.
Browser speech recognition and installed local language support vary; keyboard dictation is the fallback.
GIFs use the first frame; very large or unreadable images must be cropped/replaced.
Old public images remain viewable through ownership checks but must be attached again for a new image analysis.
Object cleanup is best-effort; crashes/storage failures can leave private orphan objects.
Existing baseline test failures and lint debt remain as listed.
